Touch controls on
Drag to pan, pinch to zoom. Move with the D-pad, or switch to a drag joystick in Settings → Access. Use the on-screen buttons for the terminal, seed, mode and player. Tap ◇ to cycle modes, or hold it for the Prev / Next / Random mini menu. Tap ≡ for the Game Menu: Back to Game, Advancements, Statistics, Guide (the tabbed manual), a bug-tracker link, Settings and Save and Quit to Title are there, and Settings holds every control plus all 70 modes.
